title: Print Header Footer Navbar Spacing Parity
description: In the Zwischenbericht mit Bestand print report, the header (navbar) and footer chrome spacing no longer matches the on-screen app UI's navbar/footer spacing. The header currently has too little vertical spacing (too cramped) and the footer has way too much spacing (too much gap). Need to bring both back into parity with the app UI's navbar/footer padding, likely by adjusting headsep/footskip and/or internal chrome bar padding in print/tex/semio-window.sty (see SemioChromeNavbarHead, SemioChromeFooterHead, headsep=\semio@spacing@double, semio@chrome@footer@reserve computation around line 2621-2634).
summary: Root vitest.config.ts only registered 2 of ~22 real vitest workspace projects, and one of the two (compose/client/lib/react/vite.config.ts) no longer existed on disk, which broke Vitest workspace loading entirely (the Vitest VS Code extension's Test Explorer would fail to discover any JS/TS tests). Rebuilt the root `projects` array to reference all 20 real vitest.config.ts files across cad/, compose/, framework/, infinite/, kernel/, and ui/, dropped the dead react reference, and added an explicit unique `test.name` to every project config (all previously defaulted to the folder-name "js" and collided). Verified with `bunx vitest run --project '*'` that the workspace now loads and discovers 944 tests across 20 projects (31 test files); the 49 failures are pre-existing ui-react component test failures unrelated to this change. Confirmed Python (pytest, .vscode/settings.json) and Rust (rust-analyzer.testExplorer) already cover all first-party test locations, and all 3 C# test projects are already registered in Monorepo.sln, so no changes were needed there.
